prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: FREAK//CITY vestibule architectural background, one new raster image for a layered pixel-art game. Create a landscape 10:7 image, ideally 1440 x 1008.

Reference 1 (approved Velvet): material roughness and sophisticated old-city nightclub painted colour only. Do NOT copy stairs, counter, window, lamps, furniture or wet floor. Reference 2 (approved street): subdued worn materials and continuity, NOT weather or facade geometry. Reference 3 (authored corridor guide): authoritative camera and opening arrangement. Retain the guide's perspective, broad framing and four dark openings as closely as possible.

Scene: a compact narrow corridor painted the colour of dried wine. Camera just inside the side entrance, looking along the corridor toward the bar ahead. Four routes: side entrance back to street in the near-left foreground (cropped at frame edge, physically behind the corridor); a smaller toilet opening farther along the left wall; bar opening centered at the far end; cloakroom opening on the right wall. Exactly these four plain openings, no others. Do not reverse left/right. Keep passage voids empty and very dark with no interior rooms visible. The near-left side entrance is an EMPTY APERTURE: absolutely no door leaf, knob, hardware or closer in this image. They will be separate overlays. All doorway frames/wall reveals are permanent architecture.

Render old worn dried-wine paint over plaster, dark wood trim, scuffed DRY matte floor, restrained atmospheric warm burgundy illumination and subtle subdued magenta/cyan material colour compatible with Velvet. Keep usable midtones and elegant depth at small pixel size. Pixel-ready hand-painted environment with painterly texture and PS1-era material roughness, carefully composed; not clean vector art, not futuristic cyberpunk. Clear dry walkable negative space for later objects and procedural Inez. Floor must be matte and dry: no puddles, wet gloss, mirror reflections, rain streaks or rain indoors.

ARCHITECTURE ONLY. Do not draw ANY furniture or loose object: no bench, ledge, chair, desk, heater, notice, signs, book, bag, envelope, paper, vessels, light fixture, cables or props. No people, bodies, silhouettes, feet or character shadows. No windows, stairs, alcoves, arches, additional doors or new passages. No text/lettering or watermark. Do not draw orange heater light or exterior doorway spill: all object-specific light and shadows will be state-owned overlays. No light bars or neon fixtures. Render only the empty permanent corridor shell, its four empty openings, and dry material texture. Geometry and object separation take priority over embellishment.
